verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
All who are thirsty
And all who are weak
Come to the fountain
Dip your heart in the streams of life

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Let the pain and the sorrow
Be washed away
In the waves of His mercy
As deep cries out to deep, we sing

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Come Lord Jesus, come
Come Lord Jesus, come
Come Lord Jesus, come
Come Lord Jesus, come

verse.name: o1a
verse.lines:
Holy Spirit come
Holy Spirit come
Holy Spirit come
Holy Spirit come

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
Come and breathe on us again
Come and breathe on us again
Come and visit us again
Come and visit us again

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
The Spirit and the bride say, come
The Spirit and the bride say, come Lord Jesus
Won’t You come Lord Jesus, come
